title: Surgical Ablation of AF Efficacy Trial
official: Surgical Ablation of AF Efficacy Trial
summary: SAFE is an international multicentre RCT of concomitant surgical atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation in patients with paroxysmal or persistent AF undergoing cardiac surgery.
